title: Flow block
summary: A few properties as a block in a flow (a chat message, a feed, any stream): shows a record's fields, or asks for a few and sends them, then keeps the answer read-only. Fields are sf-view-properties' descriptors drawn by the Framework field renderers; a press is an event, the host answers with settle.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

mode.description: view: the fields shown, read-only, with no foot. edit: the fields as controls and the answers at the foot (Send, Cancel); after the answer they are shown again, read-only.

heading.description: The header line; also the block's accessible name. Without one the block is named «Properties».

heading-level.description: The heading's level where the block is placed.

state.description: Where the answer is (edit mode). open: the controls and the answers. pending: an answer is on its way (set by a press). accepted: the values sent, read-only. declined, expired: only the outcome.

expires-at.description: ISO 8601. Past it an open block reads as expired and says so once with sf-view-flow-expired.

block-id.description: The host's name for the block, carried back in every event.

disabled.description: The controls and the answers are shown and cannot be used (an answer is on its way elsewhere in the flow).

size.description: The block's size: its text, labels and controls. 1/2 sits in a message.

cancelable.description: Whether Cancel is offered beside Send.

submit-text.description: The sending answer; empty is Send in the page's language.

cancel-text.description: The cancelling answer; empty is Cancel in the page's language.

empty-text.description: What an empty value reads as.

required-text.description: Said under a required field left empty when Send is pressed.

invalid-text.description: The status line when Send was stopped by the fields.

fields.description: The field descriptors, sf-view-properties' shape (key, label, propertyType, value, required, readonly, width, hint, options, when ...). JSON in markup; a property set from script wins.

groups.description: Named groups of field descriptors, each optionally collapsible (collapsible, collapsed). Wins over fields when both are given.

field.const: The field descriptor of simai.property-view-port (sf-view-properties): key, label, propertyType, value, required, readonly, width (half|full), hint, placeholder, options, min, max, step, unit, variant, multiple, mask, when.

answers.const: Send checks the required fields and the controls' own entries, moves the block to pending and dispatches sf-view-flow-answer {id, accepted: true, values} (cancelable; a cancelled event reopens it). Cancel dispatches {id, accepted: false}. The host answers with settle({answer: applied|refused, errors, message, values}) or sets state.

open.summary: Puts the question again (state open); asked by an assembly it answers {accepted, reason, value} when the person answers or the time runs out.

answer.summary: Answer as the person would: accepted true sends (after the block's own check of the fields), false cancels. Refused invalid, closed, disabled or prevented.

settle.summary: The host's answer to an answer, in the record port's words: {answer: applied, values?} shows the values sent, read-only; {answer: refused, errors?, message?} reopens the block with each error under its field; reason closed or expired closes it.

sf-view-flow-answer.summary: The person answered (vocabulary answer): Send with the values, or Cancel. Cancel the event to keep the block open.

values.description: With accepted true: every shown, editable field's value by key.

sf-view-flow-expired.summary: An open block passed expires-at; said once per time.

sf-view-flow-open.summary: A reference value (a record, a user) was pressed, vocabulary open: {id, field, value}. Following it is the host's.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: validating beyond required fields and the controls' own entries

untrusted_inputs: heading, labels and values (drawn by the field renderers as text)

accessibility.focus: A section named by its heading (role=heading at heading-level). The status line is a polite live region, present before it speaks; when the answers go, focus moves to it; when Send is stopped or refused, to the first field in error.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-view-flow for a few properties inside a flow: an assistant's answer showing a record, or asking the person to fill in a few fields and send them. For a record on a page or in a panel use sf-view-properties.
do_not: Do not save in the element; answer the answer event and call settle
Do not leave the block pending: settle it, or set state
Do not send markup in labels or values
